notes.title: Added new coaster! Waterworld
notes.content:
This release contains a new level, which is set far out at sea.

Enjoy the crash of the waves, meet underwater animals, and soar high above the world, plus the usual loops and turns! This is the first new level since releasing VRCE. I hope you enjoy it!

This release also contains: 
 * Major performance updates,
 * Track speed improvements,
 * Headset positioning improvements 

As always, note that VR Coaster Extreme does not support supersampling above 1.2

notes.title: Smoothness update
notes.content:
I've just pushed up an update which:

  * Greatly improves the flow of the Cave level, getting rid of nearly all of the track jerkiness
  * Improves the speed of the house level to make it more consistent and less vomit inducing
  * Improves overall performance
  * Improves head tracking, so if you stand/sit, change position it will put you in a virtualized seating position that feels more natural
  * Resolves the issue where you sometimes wouldn't complete the jumps!!
 
I have a new world (water world) that I'll be releasing real soon, hopefully this week; but I wanted to prioritize these fixes first.

Please note: Supersampling above 1.2 will almost certainly lead to a very jerky experience, irrespective of your hardware. For time being, I'm only officially supporting the default value of 1.0, as user's who are using out the box values are reporting a good experience.

As always, check the tracker to see what I'm up to, and comment here if you experience any weirdness.  https://trello.com/b/vUFkeyC0/vr-coaster-extreme-bugs-issues

notes.title: #First update patch is released!
notes.content:
I've just dropped a new update of VRCE (VR Coaster Extreme) which addresses the following fixes and improvements:

  * Improvements to Cave level, House level and Big coaster level
  * Fixing track speed and clipping issues
  * Added jumps to some levels (!)
  * Improved performance
  * Fixed issue that stops the menu finger from having the correct pointer
  * HD/Standard quality toggle in menu, for people with slower machines
  * Fixed issue of left hand being wonky in menu
  * Fixed bug that stopped pause working within first 5 seconds
  * Changed track and train in the house level
  * Improved camera positioning

Note, I did see an issue which is on the mountain level, the cart can sometimes miss the second jump !!!! I've fixed it; but I'm worried it might come back : I'm sure you guys will be kind enough to let me know if it happens again!

The Water world level has been coming along as well : I'll keep you posted about progress on that. Glad you're enjoying Virtual Reality Coaster Extreme!

Please keep tracking the issues page to monitor on-going development : https://trello.com/b/vUFkeyC0/vr-coaster-extreme-bugs-issues

 * Performance improvements for slower machines

 * Improving the track on "Honey I shrunk the coaster" level.
